events.name: Downtown Winter Farmers Market
events.place: Civic Center (by The Leonardo and Main Library), 209 E 500 S
events.note: Saturdays, Nov 14 – Apr 17. Free. Two hours free parking with validation at the library.
events.description: The Downtown Farmers Market's winter season: local produce, prepared foods and artisan goods every Saturday at Civic Center by The Leonardo and the Main Library. Free to attend.

events.name: Around the World Holiday Market
events.place: Historic Scott School, 3280 S 540 E, South Salt Lake
events.note: Tree lighting, international food and performances.
events.description: South Salt Lake Arts turns the Historic Scott School into an international holiday market with local artisans, live music and dance, small bites and warm drinks from many cultures. Includes a tree lighting ceremony and kids' crafts.

events.name: Yule Fairs at Crone's Hollow
events.place: Crone's Hollow, 3834 S Main St, South Salt Lake
events.note: Free; different vendors each week.
events.description: A three-Saturday series of Yule vendor fairs with handcrafted goods and magical treasures from local artisans. Dec 5 brings the Holly King and Krampus; Dec 12 has a Father and Mother Yule photo booth.

events.name: Christkindlmarkt SLC
events.place: This Is The Place Heritage Park, 2601 E Sunnyside Ave
events.note: Free, no tickets. Free offsite parking with shuttle; prepaid onsite parking. No pets.
events.description: Inspired by Germany's famous Christmas markets, Christkindlmarkt SLC fills This Is The Place Heritage Park with vendors, food, performances, parades and a live nativity for four days. Free to the public.

events.name: Fun Science Friday
events.place: Clark Planetarium Learning Space, 130 S 400 W
events.note: Free, no registration. Nov 13 theme: Dark Skies.
events.description: Free hands-on science projects every Friday at Clark Planetarium. November topics are tornadoes, dark skies, space toilet science and the life cycle of stars.

events.name: The Shoshone Plant Experience
events.place: Tracy Aviary, Liberty Park, 589 E 1300 S
events.note: Monthly plant walk, 3rd Wednesdays.
events.description: A plant walk with Rios Pacheco (Northwest Shoshone/Kewa Pueblo), sharing the NWB Shoshone language and traditional uses of native plants for medicine, food and shelter. Free with Tracy Aviary admission.

events.name: Bird Walk at Fielding Garr Ranch
events.place: Fielding Garr Ranch, Antelope Island State Park
events.note: Weekly Wednesdays; binoculars to borrow.
events.description: Walk the ranch's densely populated wetland in search of your bucket-list bird. Binoculars are available to borrow; no extra charge beyond park entry.

events.name: Camp Floyd Walking Tour
events.place: Camp Floyd State Park Museum, 69 W Main St, Fairfield
events.note: About an hour from SLC. Reserve: campfloyd@utah.gov.
events.description: A guided walking tour of Camp Floyd and Fairfield, including the commissary, historic Fairfield School and Stagecoach Inn.

events.name: Spirit of the Season at Camp Floyd
events.place: Camp Floyd State Park Museum, Fairfield
events.note: Holiday decorations and a Santa visit.
events.description: See how the soldiers of Camp Floyd celebrated the winter holidays, tour the Commissary and the Inn decorated for the season, and visit with Santa Claus.

events.name: Dolly & Denim at the Utah Capitol
events.place: Utah State Capitol Rotunda, 350 N State St, Salt Lake City
events.note: Free; RSVP on Eventbrite.
events.description: A free party for early literacy supporting Dolly Parton's Imagination Library in Utah. It features a conversation with Sheri Dew and live music, and guests are invited to come in their best Dolly-inspired denim.

events.name: Red Butte Garden Holiday Open House & Art Fair
events.place: Red Butte Garden, 300 Wakara Way, Salt Lake City
events.note: Free garden admission for everyone, thanks to ZAP.
events.description: Free garden admission, a glass art show and an art fair in the Orangerie with handmade gifts from 18 local makers.

events.name: Creating Christmas on Temple Square
events.place: Church History Museum, Temple Square
events.note: Free; RSVP on Eventbrite.
events.description: The Temple Square lighting crew talks about how they create the Christmas lights display each season.

events.name: Early Bird Holiday Market
events.place: Ken Garff University Club, Rice-Eccles Stadium, 451 1400 E
events.note: Free; RSVP on Eventbrite.
events.description: Get a head start on holiday shopping with local vendors at the Ken Garff University Club in Rice-Eccles Stadium.

events.name: Always Queer Market
events.place: Under the Umbrella Bookstore, 511 W 200 S #120
events.description: A pop-up market of local, queer-made crafts at Under the Umbrella Bookstore.

events.name: UMFA Holiday Market
events.place: Utah Museum of Fine Arts, 410 Campus Center Dr
events.note: Free to shop; free parking.
events.description: The UMFA's annual market of local handmade jewelry, textiles, candles, ceramics, prints, toffee and more, with live music. Proceeds support the artists and the museum.

events.name: Wisdom Keepers Holiday Arts Market
events.place: Urban Indian Center of Salt Lake, 120 W 1300 S
events.note: Free entry; donations welcome.
events.description: Handcrafted art and gifts from local artisans at the Urban Indian Center of Salt Lake.

events.name: Diwali Celebration at the Main Library
events.place: Salt Lake City Main Library, 210 E 400 S
events.description: Celebrate Diwali, the Festival of Lights, with South Asian music and dance, activities, food and a ceremonial lighting of diyas, presented with the India Cultural Center of Utah.
events.note: Free; arrive early for an auditorium seat. Performances 2–3pm and 3:30–4:30pm.

events.name: Holiday Used Book Sale
events.place: Salt Lake City Main Library, 210 E 400 S
events.description: Friends of The City Library's holiday sale of used hardbacks, paperbacks, picture books, movies and more. Proceeds fund library programs.
events.note: Free entry. Friends members-only preview Dec 3, 4:30–7:30pm.

events.name: Las Posadas Celebration
events.place: Chapman Branch Library, 577 S 900 W
events.description: A Las Posadas celebration with cookies, hot chocolate, a candle procession and chant outside, then a dance performance and piñata inside the Chapman Branch.
events.note: Free; capacity is limited. Starts outdoors, so dress warmly.

events.name: Brass & Organ Christmas Concert
events.place: Cathedral of the Madeleine, 331 E South Temple
events.description: The Eccles Organ Festival's annual Christmas concert pairs the brass section of the Utah Symphony with the cathedral's Eccles Memorial Organ, one of Salt Lake's favorite holiday music traditions.
events.note: Unticketed; first-come seating until full.

events.name: Eccles Organ Festival: Jillian Gardner
events.place: Cathedral of the Madeleine, 331 E South Temple
events.description: Organist Jillian Gardner of Huntsville, Alabama, plays a program spanning baroque works to modern voices on the cathedral's Eccles Memorial Organ.
events.note: Free and open to the public; first-come seating.

events.name: Shoreline Sentinels of Great Salt Lake: Film & Panel
events.place: Sorenson Unity Center, 1383 S 900 W
events.description: Great Salt Lake Audubon screens a 17-minute film about the snowy plovers that nest on the lake's shore, followed by a panel discussion.
events.note: Free; register on Eventbrite.
